summary: Observed 2026-11-02 (FS-GG/.github#5240): /tmp on fdev is a 16 GB tmpfs shared by every lane; it filled (about 15k entries, 9.5 GB; fifteen browser-smoke mktemp trees of about 232 MB each and a 725 MB fsgg-gate-engine cache were the bulk) and caused 38 spurious SDD test failures while many browser smokes ran and the quiet-host probe did not admit for 60 minutes. Delivered on routine/5240-fdev-host-hygiene (cited files at the cited revision; merge and install are separate effects). (1) scripts/fdev-lane-capacity.py holds at 2 or more headless Chromium MAIN processes (argv[0] Chromium binary, --headless, --remote-debugging-pipe|port, no --type=; renderer/GPU/zygote/crashpad children and node/timeout launchers do not count; --browser-hold-at, 0 disables) and when /tmp has under 3 GiB free (--min-tmp-gib, --tmp-path), JSON browsers.count/pids and tmp_free_gib. LESSON: Chromium rewrites its process title, so on fdev /proc/<pid>/cmdline is ONE space-joined string with a trailing NUL, for the main process and every --type= child; a NUL-split parser sees one word and never counts a browser, so the probe splits a single spaced field and takes argv[0] from readlink exe; checked live: one real Playwright chrome-headless-shell -> count 1, two -> hold. (2) deployment/fdev-chromium/fdev-chromium-env is now the repository source of the wrapper (it was only ~/.local/bin; environment/fdev-headless-chromium says it is not in Git, which this supersedes in fact but not by digest) and defaults TMPDIR to /home/developer/.cache/fsgg-tmp unless set, mkdir -p then chmod 0700 (shellcheck SC2174 forbids mkdir -p -m); capped at 32 bytes because a Unix socket path is at most 107 bytes and the SDD race test binds /sdd-race-characterization-<32 hex>/inputs/socket (TMPDIR plus 73); mixed TMPDIR values may fragment MSBuild node reuse; --print-tmpdir serves .NET runs. (3) scripts/fdev-tmp-cleanup.py is dry-run unless --apply and removes only known names (fsgg-sdd-tests-<pid>-* idle 1 h; fsgg-sdd-<hex>, fsgg-ai-tests/ai-tr/resolver/cli-tests-cache-sandbox-<hex>, playwright_chromiumdev_profile-*, org.chromium.Chromium.*, and tmp.* only with driver/run-smoke.mjs, idle 6 h because they carry no PID) whose owner is dead (PID absent, and no live process references the path via cmdline, environ, cwd, fd, maps or /proc/net/unix, relative words resolved against the process cwd and symlink aliases by realpath). It refuses to delete while a same-user process cannot be inspected (non-dumpable processes have a root-owned /proc dir; allowlist systemd --user, (sd-pam), sshd), uses an iterative O_NOFOLLOW directory-fd removal that never follows a symlink or crosses a mount, and refuses euid 0. playwright-artifacts-* and fsgg-gate-* are deliberately not swept. Hourly user timer templates (minute 37) and install.py tmp-cleanup and chromium-env effects ship in source; Root installs after merge. Limits: a dry run on the real host listed 874 of 1077 matched entries (3.3 GiB) removable and removed nothing; the probe samples, it does not reserve; lanes still need TMPDIR set to the disk path for the pressure to drop at the source.
title: fdev host hygiene: /tmp is a shared 16 GB tmpfs, so hold on browser count and /tmp headroom, use a short disk TMPDIR, and sweep only dead harness dirs
